result.summary: A residential intersection with sidewalks but lacking marked crosswalks or clear pedestrian-oriented traffic controls. Parked vehicles near the corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks but lacking marked crosswalks or pedestrian control signals. While the low-speed residential context is beneficial, the absence of basic crossing infrastructure and tactile warnings on curb ramps presents risks.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Tactile Warnings
hazards.description: The curb ramp lacks truncated domes, which are necessary for visually impaired pedestrians to identify the edge of the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may obstruct the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Retrofit existing ramps with detectable warning surfaces (truncated domes).

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a basic concrete sidewalk that is partially obstructed by debris and a parked vehicle. There is a complete lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or signals, which increases risk for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked car and accumulated debris on the sidewalk/verge area force pedestrians to walk closer to the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the silver car

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway and sidewalk edges show signs of wear, cracking, and debris, which can be a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line and sidewalk

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at intersections to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at potential crossing points to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Regular cleaning of debris and enforcement of parking regulations to ensure the sidewalk remains clear and usable.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps, but the pedestrian infrastructure is degraded. Crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the road surface is in poor condition, which may impact safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing area.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt at the intersection creates potential trip hazards and may affect vehicle handling.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the intersection
